1System
Choose the profile's length as you insert it — 1000 mm to start, typed or one of the preset lengths. Double-click a profile to change its length. Copy / paste a profile with Ctrl+C / Ctrl+V, or duplicate it with Ctrl+D — its LED modules, blanks and end caps all come along. If modules or blanks cover the profile completely, hold Alt — the profile lights up — and click or drag through them to grab the profile itself, or select a module or blank and press Profile in the bar over it; a selected profile is then dragged through them too.
Several at once: Left-drag on empty space: left → right selects fully enclosed profiles, corners and LED modules; right → left also selects parts touched by the box. Hold Shift to add to the selection, or Shift-click parts. Middle-drag pans the drawing; Modules can also be selected independently. A selected profile carries its modules once. Drag any of them to move them together; R or ↺ ↻ turns them as one, a quarter turn at a time; Ctrl+D duplicates, Ctrl+C / Ctrl+V copies, Delete removes them; Esc clears the selection.
Groups: select profiles and corners and press Group in the bar over them (or Ctrl+G). A group gets a name — Group 01, Group 02… — click it to rename it (e.g. “Group 01 Sofa”). From then on a click on any part of it, modules, blanks and end caps included, selects the whole group: drag, R, Ctrl+D and Delete work on all of it. Click a part of the selected group to pick just that part (double-click edits it); Ungroup (Ctrl+Shift+G) separates them again. Items, Quantities, the Excel sheet and the PDF list each group on its own, then the Total; the arrow by each heading folds its list.
2Corner joints
Snap it to a free 44 mm end of a profile. Rotate 90° with the ↺ ↻ buttons or the R. Ctrl+C / Ctrl+V or Ctrl+D copies a corner with its full spec.
3End caps
Snaps to a free 44 mm end of a straight profile and adds 2 mm to the total length.
Snaps to a free 44 mm end of a straight profile. The end cap adds 12 mm to the total length.
Snaps to a free 44 mm end of a straight profile. The end cap adds 2 mm to the total length.
4LED modules
Select a profile first — the module drops inside it. Shift-click two or more modules, then Arrange (or G) to space and center them as a group. A module can span a straight joint and is positioned from the run's zero: the left end of a horizontal run, the top end of a vertical one. Drag it along the run, or double-click to edit. Duplicate the selected module with Ctrl+D, or copy / paste with Ctrl+C / Ctrl+V. For multiple copies with spacing, use Ctrl+Shift+D (or Duplicate copies in the edit dialog). Shift-click modules on the same profile to select several and drag them together.
5Blank accessory
Select a profile, then insert. A Blank fills the largest free gap in that run. Fill gaps auto-fills every gap (edges & between modules) of the selected run — or all runs if nothing is selected.
6Canopy
Choose the canopy the system hangs from: Surface A, Surface B, Recessed or Trimless, in White or Black, for cable up to 6.0 mm or up to 8.5 mm (Surface B: 6.0 mm only). It is not drawn: it is listed as one piece, with its Cable Gland for the same cable (PRH.038 up to 6 mm, PRH.173 up to 8.5 mm), in the quantities, the Excel sheet and the PDF. The design check asks for it before an export.
7Ceiling suspension
Choose the wire suspension: 150 cm or 300 cm (ACC.286, ACC.287), or the same with safety wire (ACC.543, ACC.544). Every straight run takes one more suspension than it has profiles: 2 for a single profile, 3 for two joined profiles, 4 for three, and so on. The Cable Restraints On Wire Rope (PRH.037) come as a set: 2 with 150 cm, 3 with 300 cm, however many suspensions there are. Not drawn: listed in the quantities, the Excel sheet and the PDF. The design check asks for it before an export.

⚠ Open ends found
Every 44 mm face must be closed: profiles need an end cap, a corner joint or another profile, and every side of a corner must carry a profile. Any length of profile not covered by an LED module must carry a Blank.
Every 44 mm face must be closed: profiles need an end cap, a corner joint or another profile, and every side of a corner must carry a profile. Any length of profile not covered by an LED module must carry a Blank. A pendant design also needs its canopy and its ceiling suspension.
Click an item to zoom to it on the drawing.
Duplicate module
Copies are placed after the selected module, along its profile. Gap = free space between copies (0 = back-to-back). Center-to-center = distance between module centres. The run must have enough free length.
Arrange modules
Result—
The modules keep their current order along the run. Gap = free space between neighbours (0 = back-to-back). Center-to-center = distance between their midpoints, which differs when the modules are not the same length.
